entities.summary: Bohdan Oleksandrovych Krotevych is a Ukrainian serviceman, Lieutenant colonel of the National Guard of Ukraine, acting commander of the National Guard of Ukraine Azov Brigade, a participant of the Russian-Ukrainian war.
